test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The erroneous spelling is '**Persuit**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Among the given options the incorrectly spelt word is '**Persuit**'. • Its correct spelling is '**Pursuit**'. • It means 'the action of trying to achieve or get something'. (कुछ पाने की कोशिश) • *Example: the **pursuit** of pleasure...* • Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.** **Correct Answer:__** *Persuit.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Persuade**: to make somebody do something by giving him/her good reasons. (समझा-बुझाकर किसी को काम के लिए राज़ी करना, मनाना) • **Precede**: to happen, come or go before somebody/something. [किसी अन्‍य व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु से पहले होना, जाना या आना, पूर्ववर्ती होना (स्‍थान, समय या क्रम में)] • **Possess**: to have or own something. (किसी वस्‍तु को अधिकार में रखना या उस पर स्‍वामित्‍व होना) 3b:Ta9a, The correct answer is '**collapsed**'.
